quests.sceneText: Fishing Pier|man holding a fishing rod|metal bucket beside him|dog lying on the boards
quests.instruction: Find the person who is doing something at the end of the pier and say what he is doing.
quests.sampleAnswer: A man is fishing at the end of the pier. A metal bucket is beside him, and a dog is lying on the boards.
quests.explanation: This is the first present progressive task: 'is fishing' describes an action happening now, and it needs a person as the subject.
quests.hint: Use 'is' plus a verb ending in -ing, then add one detail about what is next to him.
quests.descriptiveTip: Specify the focal item clearly, establish spatial context using prepositions, and describe supporting elements in full sentences.
